_: steps: the keep stands on storeys of stone podium with the kit's stairs up its front (castle_builder.gd; --keep-steps=on|off), a red carpet (carpet colour, carpet_w metres wide, carpet_lift off the steps) down them and across the bailey to gate_in metres inside the gate, a guard either side of the door at the top (castle_life.gd). gate_walkers: with Meshy's open gatehouse (--landmarks=meshy), count folk (the first a guard) walk in from the road (out metres past the gate) through the passage into the bailey (inside metres in), wait_s there, and out again, abreast apart, at pace. A seat's kit castle lived in (realm/scripts/castle_life.gd; North Star docs/art/target/01-town.jpg: banners on the towers, guards on the walls, the gate lit at dusk, a well in the bailey). on: the switch (or --castle-life=on / --castle-life=off); only castles our builder raises (--castles=kit). arms: the house's painted banners hung flat where the kit castle's plain cloths hung (down the keep, either side of the gate; size: times the castle spec's banner size). banners: a house standard on each corner and gate tower (size in world units, lift: metres above the tower's top course, for its cone). guards: how many walk each curtain's walk (they turn at the towers, look out a moment, walk back; pace in metres a second; look_s: how long they stand at each end), in the castle lord's colours. torches: either side of the gate's arch (metres out from the arch's middle, how high), lit from works.json day.lit (dusk) to dawn: a warm light (energy, range in world units) and a small flame each. well: the bailey's well, in the castle's frame (world units from its middle, as the bailey's other pieces in towns.gd). Stone curtains (walls.gd, --walls=stone): the kit's curtain walls are left out of the castle and stone walls stand in their place, each taking the town's wall wear for the section it faces (bridge damage.js), so a siege breaches the castle too.
